entries.title: Pacing AI via Compute Reallocation
entries.summary: The proposal has two parts. Verified Compute Allocation Disclosures (VCAD) make labs disclose compute use, with an independent auditor checking it. Labs then shift compute from capabilities R&D to customers and safety research.
entries.analysis: Directly on your verification theme; check how the audit works.

entries.title: Where is all the AI persuasion?
entries.summary: Studies show AIs out-persuade expert humans. The author finds this does not carry over to real-world persuasion. The post asks whether progress on checkable benchmarks transfers to real deployment.
